secondary_cross_check.source_description: Earlier project workbook built from NSE Main Board and SME listing CSVs
secondary_cross_check.result: All 218 current F&O stock symbols are present in the earlier 3,195-symbol NSE universe.
secondary_cross_check.limitation: This workbook supplies symbol, company, ISIN, series and technical fields, but no company sector/industry classification. It is used only as a secondary symbol cross-check, not to infer or populate sector mappings.

classification.source: NSE Indices Industry Classification · four-tier company classification
classification.sector_taxonomy: NSDL FPI 22-sector names; NSDL cites BSE Industry Classification under the common BSE–NSE structure
classification.note: Verified rows are supported by the seven separately verified original watchlist mappings or official NSE MarketLens CSV company rows. For MarketLens rows, the Sector industry label is crosswalked to the NSDL FPI 22-sector taxonomy using the NSE Indices Industry Classification Structure; the Sub Sector macro-economic label must independently agree. Duplicate, missing, unrecognised or macro-inconsistent rows remain pending. MarketLens rows are not represented as independently audited BSE company-level confirmations. Eleven additional company rows from the 14-Nov-2026 MarketLens screener data were crosswalked and macro-sector checked: FORCEMOT, TATAELXSI, DATAPATTNS, AMBER, CUB, NBCC, CAMS, KFINTECH, PGEL, KPITTECH and CROMPTON. Two previously pending MarketLens labels were verified against the official NSE Indices hierarchy: Fertilizers & Agrochemicals → Chemicals (PIIND; Commodities macro) and IT - Services → Information Technology (SAGILITY; Information Technology macro). KAYNES remains pending because Industrial Manufacturing has no exact crosswalk in the source structure.
classification.fpi_reference_source: NSDL Fortnightly Sector-wise FPI Investment Data states that its sector classification follows BSE Industry Classification

policy: This is a research master only. It does not add dashboard cards or change the existing watchlist. Only verified sector records may be used for FPI stock tags. Pending records must fail closed and produce no tag.
